title: Remove SampleModel scaffolding (replaced by Procurement reference sample)
summary: SampleModel was the original demo entity. The Procurement reference sample replaced it. This task removes SampleModel + SampleChildModel + ESampleEnum + their controller + service + DTOs, refactors Document to a polymorphic owner pattern (OwnerType + OwnerId), drops Sample access functions, and ships a migration that drops the old tables and the FK from Documents.
